question: Compute the Z-transform of x[n] = u[n] (the discrete unit step) and state its region of convergence.
_instructions: For each step set 'human_correct' to true/false. Set 'error_type' to one of: algebra, sign, missing_term, substitution, definition, none. Set '_filled' to true when done. Set 'final_answer_correct' to true/false after comparing 'generated_final' to 'expected_final'.

steps.description: Start with the definition of the Z-transform
Since u[n] is zero for n < 0, change summation limits to start at 0
steps.notes: u[n]=0 for n<0, u[n]=1 for n≥0; sum correctly truncated to n=0..∞.

steps.description: Recognize the infinite geometric series with ratio z^(-1)

steps.notes: Standard geometric series sum Σr^n = 1/(1−r) with r = z^(-1).

steps.description: Simplify the expression by algebraic manipulation
steps.notes: Multiply numerator and denominator by z: 1/(1−1/z) = z/(z−1).

steps.description: Determine the region of convergence from the geometric series condition
steps.notes: Convergence of the geometric series requires |r| = |z^(-1)| < 1.
